commit_scope: Second alignment pass on the arrival: what a session is handed now fits in its context (the arrival 46.5 KB -> 12 KB, the roster 23.8 KB -> 2 KB), and dead tissue leaves — eighteen specs whose sources the body cut move to specs/retired with their reason, the README's footer points at living doors, the hard-data contract is one paragraph, stale cloud gotchas and a dead quickstart line are gone, CONTRIBUTING says how configuration really works.
evidence_refs: Measured 2026-10-20 11:55 WITA: the SessionStart hooks handed a session 46,506 bytes from scripts/arrival.py (the whole start packet, the whole lineage anchor, a 48-line presence tail and the full 300-line wellness reading) and 23,769 bytes from agent-coord.sh join (115 cells, 110 of them last seen more than a day ago). The harness persists hook output of that size to a file, so none of it reached the session's context — the arrival was being written for nobody.

arrival.py now carries the packet's Arrive section (the packet is one Read away), the living thread's last 16 lines (carry_thread.py already prints the chain), and the wellness reading's drift only — sections with a missing/pending/stale line keep their item lines; the whole reading lands in .cache/wellness/state.txt as before. Measured after: 12,056 bytes. agent-coord.sh join lists cells seen in the last day and counts the rest (`coord roster --all` lists them): 2,096 bytes.

The drift filter surfaced what the full reading had been hiding in its length: 84 source paths missing across 20 specs. 18 of them name sources that left the body on purpose — the kernel's cut to its end-to-end healthy flow (2026-09-29, 8a6f123d3) and the fkwu-only floor resnapshot (2026-10-18, #4068). They move to specs/retired/ with a README naming that; the ten living links to seven of them follow; specs/INDEX.md, MANIFEST.md and the routers index regenerate (the index also drops web/app/pulse/page.tsx and api/app/routers/vitality.py, both removed on main by siblings on 10-19/10-20 without a regenerated index). The two forward specs (satsang-mac-guidance-app, trusted-phone-presence) stay active and are the reading now: 7 paths across 2 specs, as active work whose source lists what will exist.

README.md is generated from README.template.md (scripts/build_readmes.py): the Documentation footer pointed at Status, Runbook, Spec Coverage, Spec Tracking and Model Routing (February–June pages no index circulates); it now points at Setup, Deploy, Production substrate, Glossary, the start packet, Who we are and Join the Network. The regenerated README also carries the new Arrive section through its include.

AGENTS.md: the Hard-Data Contract is one paragraph naming the two live doors and the fact report; the Cursor-cloud gotchas lose the 'update script' that does not exist; docs/WORKTREE-QUICKSTART.md loses the scripts/thread-runtime.sh line (no such script); CONTRIBUTING.md's 'configure environment: edit api/.env' becomes the file-backed configuration the hard rule describes.

Observed after: python3 -u scripts/arrival.py opens with Who we are and ends with the drift reading; make prompt-guide passes; the senses read proprioception aligned (152 specs) and source maps at 7 across 2 active specs.
